description: This source file defines a 'Job' class and related functions for parsing, manipulating, and exporting Gerber and Excellon PCB manufacturing files. It handles reading, processing, trimming, and rotating PCB layer data, including aperture and drill commands, for use in PCB manufacturing workflows.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a PCB manufacturing job, including parsing Gerber and Excellon files, managing layer commands, apertures, and drill data, and exporting the data with coordinate transformations.

classes.name: JobLayout
classes.description: Encapsulates a Job with positional offsets, providing methods to write Gerber and Excellon data at specific locations, and to generate outline and drill hit visuals.

methods.name: rotateJob
methods.description: Creates a rotated copy of a Job object by specified degrees in 90-degree increments, adjusting all commands, apertures, and drill data accordingly.
